kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-rcs-template --template-type 0 --related-sign-names '阿里云1,阿里云2' --template-name '短信阈值告警模版' --template-content '尊敬的用户_username_，您的账号_account_今日已达到发送量上限。' --template-format RICH_MEDIA --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRCSTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Valid values:

0: verification code.
1: notification.
2: promotional message
parameters.help_zh:
短信类型。取值：

0：验证码。
1：短信通知。
2：推广短信
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en:
The SMS signature name.

Plain text template: multiple signatures are supported. Separate multiple signatures with commas (,).

Rich media template: only a single signature is supported
parameters.help_zh:
短信签名名称。

文本模板：支持传入多个签名，多个签名用英文逗号分隔。

富媒体模板：只支持单个签名
parameters.name: related_sign_names

parameters.help_en:
The template variable rules in JSON format. The rules must correspond one-to-one with the variables in the template content. The format is {"variable_name1":"variable_type1","variable_name2":"variable_type2"}. Valid values for variable types:

ANY: any text variable. Used in Card.Title, Card.Description, or plain text template content. Can be concatenated with constants or other variables.
MEDIA: asset code variable. Must exclusively occupy the entire value of the MediaCode field. Concatenation is not allowed. The value is the asset code (assetCode).
MENU_ANY: full floating menu variable. Must exclusively occupy the entire value of TemplateMenu or CardMenu within a card. For example, TemplateMenu is set to ${menu}. Concatenation is not allowed. Pass in the complete menu JSON when sending.
RCS_ANY: full rich media variable. Must exclusively occupy the entire TemplateContent. That is, TemplateContent is set to ${Content}. Concatenation is not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
模板变量规则，JSON格式，需与模板内容中的变量一一对应。格式为{"变量名1":"变量类型1","变量名2":"变量类型2"}。变量类型取值：

ANY：任意文本变量。用于Card.Title、Card.Description或纯文本模板内容，可与常量或其他变量拼接。
MEDIA：素材编码变量。必须独占MediaCode字段的整个值，不允许拼接，值为素材编码assetCode。
MENU_ANY：悬浮菜单全变量。必须独占TemplateMenu或卡片内CardMenu的整个值，例如TemplateMenu取值为${menu}，不允许拼接，发送时传入完整菜单JSON。
RCS_ANY：富媒体全变量。必须独占整个TemplateContent，即TemplateContent取值为${Content}，不允许拼接
parameters.name: template_rule

parameters.example: 尊敬的用户${username}，您的账号${account}今日已达到发送量上限。
parameters.help_en:
The template content.

For plain text templates, the content is in string format.

For rich media templates, the content is in JSON format or full variable mode ${Content}. The rich media JSON structure contains a Cards array and a Layout object. For more information, see the TemplateContent rich media template JSON structure below
parameters.help_zh:
模板内容。

纯文本模板为字符串格式。

富媒体模板为JSON格式或全变量模式${Content}。富媒体JSON结构包含Cards数组和Layout对象，具体说明请参见下方TemplateContent富媒体模板JSON结构
parameters.name: template_content

parameters.help_en:
The floating menu in JSON format. Pass in the complete floating menu JSON with suggestions as the root field. For example, {"suggestions":[...]}. For the specific structure and field constraints, see the TemplateMenu floating menu syntax description in the supplementary request parameter description.

Full variable mode is supported. That is, TemplateMenu is set to ${param_key}. The variable type must be MENU_ANY, and the variable must exclusively occupy the entire value of TemplateMenu. Concatenation is not allowed.
CardMenu embedded within cards (Cards[].CardMenu) also supports the MENU_ANY full variable
parameters.help_zh:
悬浮菜单，JSON格式。必须以suggestions为根字段传入完整悬浮菜单JSON，例如{"suggestions":[...]}。具体结构与字段约束参见请求参数补充说明中的TemplateMenu悬浮菜单语法说明。

支持全变量模式，即TemplateMenu取值为${param_key}，变量类型须为MENU_ANY，且变量必须独占整个TemplateMenu的值，不允许拼接。
卡片内嵌菜单Cards[].CardMenu同样支持MENU_ANY全变量
parameters.name: template_menu

parameters.help_en:
The templatetype. Valid values:

PLAIN_TEXT: plain text template.
RICH_MEDIA: rich media template
parameters.help_zh:
模板类型。取值：

PLAIN_TEXT：纯文本模板。
RICH_MEDIA：富媒体模板
parameters.name: template_format
